ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a visit from {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone laid up in bed or convalescing hasn't seen a good friend for days and would like them to come and sit for a while.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {OTHER_nameDef} sits with {FOR_nameDef} for a while. Promising it sends {OTHER_objective} over now, if {OTHER_pronoun} is free.

plain.li: Could someone ask {OTHER_nameDef} to come by? I haven't seen {OTHER_objective} in days.
I keep hearing {OTHER_nameDef}'s voice outside. I'd like to see {OTHER_possessive} face for once.
If {OTHER_nameDef} has an hour, I'd be glad of the company.
Lying here all day, I've run out of things to think about. {OTHER_nameDef} always has something to say.
[winter] The nights are long in here. Ask {OTHER_nameDef} to sit with me one evening.
[child] Can {OTHER_nameDef} come and see me? Please?
[old] At my age a sickbed gets lonely. I'd like {OTHER_nameDef} to visit.

warm.li: I miss {OTHER_nameDef}. Just an hour would do me more good than the medicine.

blunt.li: Tell {OTHER_nameDef} to come and see me.

cheerful.li: I'm bored out of my mind! Send {OTHER_nameDef} over before I start talking to the wall.

gloomy.li: Nobody comes in here. I'd hoped {OTHER_nameDef} might.

cold.li: I'd like to speak with {OTHER_nameDef}. I have time, for once.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came. We talked until I fell asleep.
That was the best hour I've had since I took to this bed.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came by! I feel better already.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} never came. I suppose everyone's busy.
